title: Movement adjudicator and DATC qualification
summary: Existing authoritative movement API, literal coast rule and confirmed convoy/support choices: 39 original cases, 130 DATC v3.0-derived positions, 6 additional v3.4 and 2 strict regressions; reversed-insertion replay.
invariants: Units keyed by province; submitted keyed by power with arrays of original lines. Inputs remain unchanged.
Result exposes units, dislodged tuple (original unit, attacker origin, convoy flag), outcomes, standoffs, paradoxes and published power/original/status records.
Rules loaded from data/rules.conf; no player legal-order interface.
Explicit VIA CONVOY for adjacent convoy intent; Szykman backup; distinct physically impossible convoy versus missing matching orders.
Recursive decision trials check final equations except explicit paradox overrides; bounded 4096 trials fail closed.

Original trial-based adaptation; Claude reviewed dev4 and reported no failures in 98000 random/mutated positions, no trial cap exhaustion. F2 strict support-coast option explicitly authorised by Tom on 2026-11-26.
A future caller must trap unresolved syntax 93.900, log failure and stop rather than publish a board.
COAST_REQUIRED=ALWAYS and SUPPORT_COAST=STRICT; missing split fleet coast NO_COAST, wrong BAD_COAST. No coast repair; support destination matches exact named coast.
Fresh dev4r4 mutation audit: 10000 mixed + 10000 convoy-derived fixture mutations, zero failures, 1330 paradox trials. Dev4r3 1393 and dev4r2 1419 remain historical.

Architect confirmed: a nonadjacent army move is an implicit convoy if a physical route exists; orders must establish a surviving matching convoy. Adjacent army defaults to land unless VIA CONVOY. Province-level support reach including other coast is valid; assisted fleet destination must match exactly.

evidence.scope: B.2/B.7/B.8/B.15 updated strict outcomes; B.16/B.17 strict board unchanged and BAD_COAST diagnostics. F.28/F.29 unavailable.

procedure: Use sh tests/run.sh with rexx on PATH and ALCHEMY_REPO_ROOT set.
Preserve movement result for seasonal API; no inferred coast. No claim of full DATC conformity.
